_doc: Migrations in supabase/migrations that the PROD_SHADOW bootstrap does NOT apply. Every other migration (including future ones) is applied in lexical order after 000_prehistory_baseline.sql, so current-main schema truth is never frozen. A migration is excluded only if the shadow-reachable path (producer -> GSP/serving -> Contract A -> Reservation -> baseline -> rebalance -> Queue boundary -> passive block) provably never touches its objects.
